Member.title: Member
Member.description: Represents a registered member of the church, including their personal information, contact details, church title, and family relationships.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Member entity.

koreanName.description: The member's full name in Korean.

englishName.description: The member's full legal name in English.

title.description: The member's church title or position. Options include: '없음' (No title), '서리집사' (Deacon), '안수집사' (Ordained Deacon), '은퇴장로' (Retired Elder), '시무장로' (Senior Elder), '목회자' (Pastor).

titleAppointmentDate.description: The date when the member was appointed to their church title.

titleAppointmentPlace.description: The place where the member was appointed to their church title.

addressLine1.description: The first line of the member's current address.

addressLine2.description: The second line of the member's current address (e.g., apartment, suite number).

city.description: The city of the member's current address.

state.description: The state or province of the member's current address.

zipCode.description: The postal code of the member's current address.

spouseId.description: Reference to the spouse's Member ID, if they are also a registered member. (Relationship: Member 1:1 Member)

parentIds.description: References to the parent's Member IDs, if they are also registered members. (Relationship: Member N:N Member)

childrenIds.description: References to the children's Member IDs, if they are also registered members. (Relationship: Member N:N Member)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the member record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the member record was last updated.

Department.title: Department
Department.description: Represents a department or ministry within the church (e.g., Worship, Education, Finance).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Department entity.

name.description: The name of the department (e.g., 'Worship Department', 'Finance Department').

description.description: A brief description of the department's purpose or activities.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the department record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the department record was last updated.

ChatRoom.title: ChatRoom
ChatRoom.description: Represents a chat conversation, which can be either a private chat between two members or a group chat.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ChatRoom entity.

name.description: The name of the chat room, primarily used for group chats (e.g., 'Worship Team Chat').

type.description: The type of chat room, either 'private' for one-on-one chats or 'group' for multi-member chats.

departmentId.description: Reference to the Department ID if this chat room is specifically for a church department. (Relationship: Department 1:N ChatRoom)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the chat room was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the chat room was last updated (e.g., name changed, last message received).

ChatParticipant.title: ChatParticipant
ChatParticipant.description: Represents a member's participation in a specific chat room.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ChatParticipant entity.

memberId.description: Reference to the Member ID who is participating in the chat. (Relationship: Member 1:N ChatParticipant)

chatRoomId.description: Reference to the ChatRoom ID the member is participating in. (Relationship: ChatRoom 1:N ChatParticipant)

joinedAt.description: Timestamp when the member joined the chat room.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message sent within a chat room.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Message entity.

chatRoomId.description: Reference to the ChatRoom ID where the message was sent. (Relationship: ChatRoom 1:N Message)

senderId.description: Reference to the Member ID who sent the message. (Relationship: Member 1:N Message)

content.description: The text content of the message.

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

FileAttachment.title: FileAttachment
FileAttachment.description: Represents a file or photo attached to a message.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FileAttachment entity.

messageId.description: Reference to the Message ID this file is attached to. (Relationship: Message 1:N FileAttachment)

fileName.description: The original name of the attached file.

fileType.description: The MIME type of the file (e.g., 'image/jpeg', 'application/pdf').

fileUrl.description: The URL where the file is stored.

thumbnailUrl.description: The URL for a thumbnail image, primarily for photo attachments.

uploadedAt.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded.

Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: Represents an announcement sent by an administrator to individual members.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Announcement entity.

senderId.description: Reference to the Member ID who sent the announcement (expected to be an admin). (Relationship: Member 1:N Announcement)

recipientId.description: Reference to the Member ID who is the recipient of this individual announcement. (Relationship: Member 1:N Announcement)

content.description: The main text content of the announcement.

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the announcement was sent.

TithingRecord.title: TithingRecord
TithingRecord.description: Represents a single tithing contribution made by a church member.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TithingRecord entity.

memberId.description: Reference to the Member ID who made the tithe. (Relationship: Member 1:N TithingRecord)

amount.description: The amount of the tithing contribution.

tithingDate.description: The date when the tithe was made.

description.description: An optional description or memo for the tithing record.

recordedByMemberId.description: Reference to the Member ID (expected to be a finance elder) who recorded this tithing. (Relationship: Member 1:N TithingRecord)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the tithing record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the tithing record was last updated.

Hymn.title: Hymn
Hymn.description: Represents a single hymn from the integrated Korean/English New Hymnal.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Hymn entity.

hymnNumber.description: The official number of the hymn in the hymnal.

koreanTitle.description: The title of the hymn in Korean.

englishTitle.description: The title of the hymn in English.

koreanLyrics.description: The full lyrics of the hymn in Korean.

englishLyrics.description: The full lyrics of the hymn in English.

sheetMusicUrl.description: URL to copyright-free sheet music for the hymn.

BibleBook.title: BibleBook
BibleBook.description: Represents a book of the Bible (e.g., Genesis, Matthew).

id.description: Unique identifier for the BibleBook entity.

koreanName.description: The name of the Bible book in Korean.

englishName.description: The name of the Bible book in English.

abbreviation.description: A common abbreviation for the Bible book (e.g., '창', 'Gen').

bookOrder.description: The canonical order of the Bible book (e.g., Genesis is 1, Exodus is 2).

BibleChapter.title: BibleChapter
BibleChapter.description: Represents a chapter within a Bible book.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BibleChapter entity.

bookId.description: Reference to the BibleBook ID this chapter belongs to. (Relationship: BibleBook 1:N BibleChapter)

chapterNumber.description: The sequential number of the chapter within its book.

BibleVerse.title: BibleVerse
BibleVerse.description: Represents a single verse of the Bible, including its Korean and English text.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BibleVerse entity.

chapterId.description: Reference to the BibleChapter ID this verse belongs to. (Relationship: BibleChapter 1:N BibleVerse)

verseNumber.description: The sequential number of the verse within its chapter.

koreanText.description: The text of the Bible verse in Korean (Revised Korean Version).

englishText.description: The text of the Bible verse in English (e.g., KJV, NIV, etc.).

Sermon.title: Sermon
Sermon.description: Represents a recorded sermon, including its details and a link to its video.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Sermon entity.

preacherId.description: Reference to the Member ID of the preacher. (Relationship: Member 1:N Sermon)

sermonDate.description: The date when the sermon was delivered.

youtubeUrl.description: The YouTube URL where the sermon video is hosted.

thumbnailUrl.description: The URL for the sermon video's thumbnail image.

uploadedByMemberId.description: Reference to the Member ID (expected to be a Senior Elder) who uploaded this sermon link. (Relationship: Member 1:N Sermon)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the sermon record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the sermon record was last updated.

Bulletin.title: Bulletin
Bulletin.description: Represents a weekly church bulletin, available as a file upload.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Bulletin entity.

bulletinDate.description: The date for which this weekly bulletin is valid.

fileUrl.description: The URL to the uploaded bulletin file (PDF, JPG, or PNG).

uploadedAt.description: Timestamp when the bulletin file was uploaded.

definition.description: Stores individual member profiles. The document ID (`memberId`) should correspond to the Firebase Auth UID. Read/write access is typically restricted to the owner (`request.auth.uid == memberId`) or administrative roles. Basic profile information can be viewable by other members.

Designated collection to grant Senior Elder role based on document existence. The document ID (`seniorElderId`) must be the Firebase Auth UID of the member. This enables robust DBAC (Database Access Control) without custom claims.

params.name: seniorElderId
params.description: The Firebase Auth UID of a member who has the Senior Elder role.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for EkklesiaConnect prioritizes Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and consistent Access Modeling to ensure robust, debuggable, and scalable security rules. 

**Authorization Independence via Denormalization:**
*   **Chat Rooms (`/chatRooms/{chatRoomId}`), Messages (`/chatRooms/{chatRoomId}/messages/{messageId}`), and File Attachments (`/chatRooms/{chatRoomId}/messages/{messageId}/fileAttachments/{fileAttachmentId}`):** To avoid hierarchical authorization dependencies (i.e., `get()` operations on parent documents), chat room documents will contain a denormalized map of `members: { [memberId]: true }`. For subcollections like messages and attachments, security rules will leverage the `exists()` function on the `/chatRooms/{chatRoomId}/participants/{memberId}` subcollection. This `participants` subcollection explicitly marks a user's membership in a chat room. By checking `exists(/chatRooms/$(resource.data.chatRoomId)/participants/$(request.auth.uid))`, rules can verify membership without needing to read the entire parent `chatRoom` document, fulfilling the Authorization Independence mandate. For message and attachment creation, the `senderId` will be denormalized into the document, and checked against `request.auth.uid` along with the `exists()` check for participation.
*   **Announcements (`/members/{recipientId}/announcements/{announcementId}`):** These are private to the recipient. The `recipientId` is explicitly part of the document path, making ownership clear and removing the need for `get()` calls. The `senderId` (an admin) is denormalized within the document, and sender authorization is managed by checking the `roles_admins` collection.
*   **Tithing Records (`/members/{memberId}/tithingRecords/{tithingRecordId}`):** Similar to announcements, `memberId` is in the path for individual ownership. The `recordedByMemberId` (finance elder) is denormalized, and finance elder authorization is managed by checking the `roles_financeElders` collection.
*   **Sermons (`/sermons/{sermonId}`):** The `uploadedByMemberId` (senior elder) is denormalized. Authorization for uploads is based on the `roles_seniorElders` collection.

**Structural Segregation for QAPs (Query As A Policy):**
*   **Role Collections:** Dedicated, top-level collections like `/roles_seniorElders/{seniorElderId}`, `/roles_leadPastors/{leadPastorId}`, `/roles_financeElders/{financeElderId}`, and `/roles_admins/{adminId}` are used for Database Access Control (DBAC). The *existence* of a document in these collections grants the respective role. This makes rules clear and allows efficient role-based checks (e.g., `allow read: if exists(/roles_seniorElders/$(request.auth.uid))`).
*   **Public Data:** Collections like `/hymns`, `/bibleBooks`, `/departments`, `/sermons`, and `/bulletins` are segregated as publicly readable. This simplifies security rules to `allow read: true` for all authenticated users (or even unauthenticated if desired), as there are no mixed security postures within these collections.
*   **Private User Data:** `/members/{memberId}` and its subcollections (`/members/{memberId}/tithingRecords`, `/members/{memberId}/announcements`) are designed using hierarchical paths to inherently enforce ownership. A user's `memberId` must match the path's `{memberId}` wildcard, making read access for individual users straightforward and secure.
*   **Chat Access:** Group chat access for Senior Elders and the Lead Pastor is implemented as a global `exists()` check against their respective role collections, ensuring they can query and read all relevant chat data regardless of individual room membership. Regular members, however, must be explicitly listed as a `participant` via `exists()` for a specific chat room.

The user's reported `auth/invalid-api-key` error is a client-side Firebase configuration issue (likely a missing or incorrect `apiKey` in `firebaseConfig`) and is unrelated to the Firestore data structure design itself. This structure design assumes a correctly initialized Firebase client and authenticated users (`request.auth.uid` is available).
